releases.name: wizardingcode-mem 0.5.0
releases.body:
## Install

From inside your agent — see the [README](https://github.com/WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-mem#install) for each one. For example:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-plugins && claude plugin install wizardingcode-mem@wizardingcode-plugins
codex plugin marketplace add WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-plugins && codex plugin add wizardingcode-mem@wizardingcode-plugins
```

The `wizardingcode-mem-*` files are the binaries the plugins fetch.

## Changes

- Release 0.5.0 (#16)

releases.name: Model: potion-multilingual-128M (v1)
releases.body:
The optional model behind wizardingcode-mem's search by meaning (`wizardingcode-mem embed download`, or the Settings → Search card). Nothing downloads it unless you ask.

- `potion-multilingual-128M.wcpack`: [minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M](https://huggingface.co/minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M) at revision `73908c3438cf03b6a01bcb9611d62b23d0726f08`, repackaged unchanged for the TypeScript engine; `scripts/embed/pack.ts` rebuilds it byte for byte.
  sha256 `7d8362253e568e7bb24ff8be3f006f412973aa445a96c4c17b6f13a957825c6a`, 146,383,528 bytes.
- `LICENSE-potion.txt`: the model's MIT licence (Minish Lab).

The binary checks the size and the sha256 before using the file.

releases.name: wizardingcode-mem 0.4.4
releases.body:
## Install

From inside your agent — see the [README](https://github.com/WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-mem#install) for each one. For example:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-plugins && claude plugin install wizardingcode-mem@wizardingcode-plugins
gemini extensions install https://github.com/WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-mem
```

The `*.wizardingcode-mem.tar.gz` files are the Gemini CLI extension; the `wizardingcode-mem-*` files are the binaries the other plugins fetch.
